notes.title: Patch 2.1.6
notes.content:
Minor quality of life update:
The spawn icon for blade enemies on levels 2 and 3 will be slightly larger than other enemies

notes.title: Patch 2.1.4
notes.content:
Minor menu bug fixes

Attempted to fix issue where sometimes the wave would not progress on the first level

Fixed fade bug with practice buttons.

Fixed issue where clicking the :Retry Level: button was not working

Now if you die in hardcore mode, it will quickly restart rather than making you go back out to the menu
